title: Signal: Host-based authentication allows every address in postgres — review required
scope: Single-line match on an any-address host entry in postgres.
limitations: Lexical: matches one pg_hba line; actual reachability depends on network controls that the file cannot show.

examples.line: # audit: host    all             all             0.0.0.0/0               scram-sha-256 present

fpNotes: A database reachable only through a private network with a documented topology is the accepted exception.
